spec.baseline: Identical timestamp ordinary Tokyo bank-day USDJPY markouts

costs.cost_source: illustrative, actual historical executable broker spread unavailable

evaluation.calendar: Preserve prior official BOJ plus Japan Cabinet Office holiday/date registry, nominal 5 10 15 20 25 30, holiday rollback as an assumption, month-end independently labeled
evaluation.controls: Weekday and year only; no post-treatment controls
evaluation.data_gate: Per-interval complete contiguous minute opens with no forward fill, record cohort sizes and missingness; do not require 03-12 completeness for 09:56-10:10 test
evaluation.gate_definition: Original prior 20 complete 08:00-10:30 bank-session extension, lagged, from original_gate_history.parquet
evaluation.retrospective_status: All 2020 through Aug 2026 was already explored
evaluation.tests: Per-interval HAC calendar effects and Holm over 18 increment tests plus B post-fix subgroups and placebo

spec.falsifier: No live approval unless positive calendar-controlled Gotobi incremental return survives multiplicity adjustment, positive costed mean confidence lower bound, stable years, placebo specificity, and adequate eligible-day coverage. All retests are retrospective, not independent OOS.

instruments.identity: LSE spot USDJPY 1-minute OHLC as broker price proxy, JPY per USD

spec.mechanism: Corporate USD settlement flow could alter USDJPY drift before 09:55 JST and dealer inventory might unwind afterward. Gotobi calendar is a proxy.
spec.thesis: Coverage-corrected retrospective closure of Program 1, with the original economic hypotheses A through D and unchanged USDJPY fixing schedule. Compare Gotobi against ordinary Tokyo bank days, independently for each declared observation horizon. Do not claim discovery from reusing observed data.

trials.description: Window-specific completeness and source identity, calendar group composition
A and earlier entry L interval results with HAC/adjusted Gotobi increment
B0 ordinary B1 Gotobi B2 month-end B3 historical conditional per exit horizon
Yearly, placebo and negative control and program-wide Holm comparisons
Reconcile previous native engine runs and final research disposition
